months.note: 봄과 가을에 지나가며, 번식지에서는 5월 중순~7월 중순에 알을 낳는다.

summary: 봄과 가을에 작은 무리로 지나가는 비교적 드문 나그네새이다. 땅 위를 뛰어다니며 다리로 낙엽을 헤쳐 먹이를 찾고, 곤충과 식물 열매를 주로 먹는다. 잡목림, 낙엽활엽수림, 적송림, 아고산대 침엽수림 등에 둥지를 틀고 한배에 알을 3~4개, 보통 3개 낳는다. 중국과 시베리아 등지에 분포하고 동남아시아에서 겨울을 난다.

art.subject: Siberian Thrush (Geokichla sibirica), adult male on autumn passage (September–October): whole plumage very dark slate-grey, looking blackish in shade; crown feathers black with slightly paler slaty edges; black lores; a broad, bold, pure white supercilium from just in front of the eye curving back to the side of the neck; centre of the lower belly and undertail coverts white with slate scaling; wings and tail blackish-slate, the outer tail feathers with small white tips; bill black; brown iris; orange-yellow legs.
art.pose: hopping on the forest floor, flicking fallen leaves aside with its feet
art.scene: Korean autumn deciduous woodland floor covered with fallen leaves; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view on the forest floor: very dark slate-grey plumage, black lores, broad white supercilium reaching the neck side, white-scaled vent, black bill, orange-yellow legs
adult male, head close-up in profile: black crown feathers with slaty edges, black lores, long broad white eyebrow, black bill

adult female, side view on the ground: olive-brown upperparts, buff supercilium, whitish underparts densely scaled brown on the breast and flanks, dark brown upper mandible, lower mandible pale with a dark brown tip, orange-yellow legs
adult male in flight, seen from below: two broad white bands across the dark underwing, white-tipped outer tail feathers; head, body and tail in a straight line
art.build: Medium-sized ground thrush, about 23cm, clearly larger than a sparrow and smaller than a pigeon; plump and compact with a rounded head, rather short square tail and fairly long legs. Bill straight, about two-thirds of the head length. Hops on the forest floor in a horizontal stance and flicks fallen leaves aside with its feet. In flight from below the underwing shows two broad white bands across the dark wing lining.
avoid: Do not paint a yellow bill or a glossy all-black body like a blackbird; the bill is black and the plumage dark slate-grey.
Do not shorten or narrow the white supercilium; it is broad and runs back to the side of the neck.
Do not paint an orange breast or a spotted white belly (Japanese Thrush and Eyebrowed Thrush traits).
Do not paint pink or dark legs; they are orange-yellow.
